title: eval top-up-set job payload

minBuild.description: The oldest worker build that may run the job; an older instance requeues it without an attempt (engine design §9.1).

traceparent.description: traceparent of the job that enqueued this continuation; the job's span links to it (engine design §17).

description: Payload of an eval job of kind top-up-set (processing design §13.3): retires stale generated questions and regenerates to the target size with a new round seed (weekly check or on demand). Dedup eval-generate:{collectionId}.
